doc: Where every field of a lane record lands in an item record. fromLaneRecord() in record-format.mjs implements it. how: copy = the value as written, at the item path; map = converted by the rule in note; reserved = kept empty in piece 1. The selftest fails when the lane writes a field that has no row here, or a row names a field the lane no longer writes, so a new lane field must state where it goes. Context, not a record field: repo comes from the tick (summary.repo, UPGRADE_AGENT_REPO).

Since story 549: the stalled-check retry for this PR as the tick read it: state (not-needed, eligible, deferred, selected, ticked, not-written, write-failed, waiting-for-renovate, new-head-checks-running, resolved, failed-again, no-new-head, not-retried-again, budget-used, not-eligible, unreadable), why, count_7d, limits and history (head, at, status, outcome, next_head) from data.retry_ledger. A retry is a Renovate rebase, not an attempt on the item: it writes no event. Copied as written.

Since story 593: the item's terminal event as the history (ConfigMap upgrade-agent/upgrade-ledger) recorded it: type (merged or closed), at, state, by, item, event and merge_commit; null on an open PR. Set on the record of a PR that left the open list, which the lane edits once (never a new comment). Not converted: the item's state and attempts come from its events in the history, and fromLaneRecord reads the lane verdict only.

Since story 752: the tick's merge-step verdict for the PR it ran on (at, mode, chosen, verdict, pr_refusals, lane_refusals, merge_call), {} on every other record. Copied as written. It is not the item's attempts: attempts[] is rebuilt from events, and a live verdict becomes events by the table merge_step_verdicts below (eventsFromMergeStep, which reads the full verdict summary.merge_step because only it carries the merge commit).

merge_step_verdicts.doc: What one merge-step verdict (summary.merge_step, story 752) writes to the history. Only live mode writes events: a dry-run verdict was never acted on and stays in lane_detail.last_attempt. A refusal that names any lane refusal (class not allowlisted, token, not chosen, lease, window, gate age, lock move, a settle fact or a yield to a shepherd Job, story 551) is the lane declining, not an attempt on the item, and writes nothing. eventsFromMergeStep() in record-format.mjs implements this table; every event carries the attempt the first one opens.

refused (live, PR refusals only): merge-refused (class merge-step-refused, to needed: the open state follows the lane's next read)
merged: merged (evidence merge_commit from merged.merge_commit; with no merge commit it is recorded as merge-unknown)
merging (hand run, night-merge.mjs --mer: recorded by the hand run itself, actor hand (story 712)

not_item_fields.doc: Tick-level summary keys of upgrade-lane-state that are not item fields. They stay in upgrade-lane-state; the history keeps what matters from them as events.
not_item_fields.summary.merge_step: the source of the merge-step events (table above)
not_item_fields.summary.change_lock: the lock's outcome and phase; each phase goes with an item state (lock_phases in upgrade-states.v1.json)
not_item_fields.summary.token_permissions: the tick's token, a lane refusal when it cannot merge
not_item_fields.summary.owed_work: verification and revert owed (stories 553, 753, 754): the item states merged_unverified, awaiting_pin, failed, reverting, reverted_unverified, merge_unknown
not_item_fields.summary.live_classes: the live allowlist, a lane refusal when the class is not on it
